en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a small European town nestled in a valley with surrounding rolling fields. Dense rows of multi‑story houses and small apartment buildings fill the foreground and middle, with a prominent church tower rising near the right side of the town. In the distance are patchwork agricultural fields and scattered farmhouses. The word "Rosswein" is printed in a cursive typeface at the upper left, suggesting the town's name.
